title: Wolf Adventure on screen (stage, objective line, vignette cards, talk panel, handout viewer, roll/dice, turn tracker, quiz)
layout_order: stage over the world (letterbox bars top and bottom, fade, chapter title card in the upper third) | objective line plate (340 wide, right edge at the game HUD's right, standing on it; under the notices when the bottom is taken) | vignette card centred in the upper third (older cards peek above; source + X, title, speaker, picture, text, options or Continue, timer bar, More time) | talk panel above the game HUD left of centre (source + X, portrait, line, replies in two columns, text box + Say + Give, characters left, bag picker) | roll plate above the talk panel | turn tracker top centre (head, fighters' plates, moves / Attack whom? / End turn) | quiz plate upper part (QUIZ + X, title, question, choices or field, Previous ... Next/Submit) | handout viewer (title + X, picture, text, Close at the foot)
